entry.title: NoirSonance Releases Headroomer Channel Cleanup Plugin
entry.content:
Bedroom Producers Blog | bedroomproducersblog.com | discussion

NoirSonance has released Headroomer, a channel cleanup plugin compatible with macOS and Windows. The plugin is offered via a free or "pay-what-you-want" licensing model.

Headroomer is designed as a utility for producers and audio engineers to assist with cleaning up audio channels. It is available for both major desktop operating systems.

entry.title: W.A. Production Offers Presser Compressor Plugin for Free
entry.content:
Bedroom Producers Blog | bedroomproducersblog.com | source | discussion

The Presser compressor plugin from W.A. Production is available for free until September 6. Developed in collaboration with producer Aiden Kenway, the tool allows users to adjust dynamic range while adding punch and presence to audio signals.

The plugin features an intuitive interface designed for character-driven audio shaping. The offer is being facilitated through The Beat Community platform.

entry.title: Shadaloo Audio DSP Makes Density EQ Permanently Free
entry.content:
Bedroom Producers Blog | bedroomproducersblog.com | source | discussion

Shadaloo Audio DSP has transitioned its Density EQ plugin to a permanent free offering. The plugin is a four-band equalizer designed to shape the presence and weight of audio tracks, aiming to increase track scale and mix-readiness without introducing harmonic harshness or muddiness.

The decision to make the tool free is intended to increase accessibility and allow a wider range of users to test the plugin's capabilities. Density EQ is available in VST3 format.

entry.title: EDM Producers Call Out AI-Generated Music Passed Off as Human Art
entry.content:
Techmeme | theverge.com

Electronic dance music producers are identifying and exposing AI-generated tracks presented as human-made. As generative tools like Suno enable users to create songs with minimal effort, artists such as Max “H4RRIS” Harris and Nihil Young are calling out 'AI slop' to protect the authenticity of the genre and the livelihoods of human creators.

The movement responds to a growing culture of mistrust fueled by audio artifacts like vocal stuttering and persistent hissing. While AI music has achieved mainstream success on TikTok and the Billboard charts, producers argue that generative tools threaten human artistry and the clarity of musical styles.
